_comment: Run modifiers (M64, src/sim/modifiers.js): picked on a new game's last screen, each changing the start only. A burden is open from the first game; a boon opens once the record (src/sim/record.js) has reached its unlock: { act } reached by any run, or { won: true } the reckoning won. start: credits (added), heat (set at least), standing (added on every side, held within its range), crew (-1: the last who isn't the captain stays behind), parts (that many more of each part the start gives).

modifiers.name: Wanted
modifiers.text: You start with 30 heat: the pursuer is already looking.

modifiers.name: Skeleton crew
modifiers.text: One fewer crew member at the start, never the captain.

modifiers.name: Bad blood
modifiers.text: Every side thinks 3 less of you.

modifiers.name: Spare crates
modifiers.text: One more of each part you start with.

modifiers.name: Old friends
modifiers.text: Every side thinks 3 more of you.
